test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The radius of the base of a right circular cone is 28 cm and its slant height is 13 cm. Find its lateral surface area. (Use pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of the cone (r) = 28 cm

Slant height of the cone (l) = 13 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Lateral Surface Area of a cone = π × r × l

**Calculation:**

Lateral Surface Area = π × r × l

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 22/7 × 28 × 13

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = (22 × 4) × 13

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 88 × 13

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 1144 cm²

**The lateral surface area of the cone is 1144 cm².**
